card.category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target
card.summary: No free download allowance is published; the site sells '3.00 TB space as free user' of storage, which is a storage figure and not a download one.

record.category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: No free download allowance is published; the site sells '3.00 TB space as free user' of storage, which is a storage figure and not a download one.

per_object_cap.stated: upload/download up to 50 GB per file on premium

retention.stated: not stated on the premium page

egress.terms: Premium is sold as a bandwidth block with storage attached: '1 TB bandwidth / 1 TB storage' at each price point, plus 'Unlimited simultaneous downloads'.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB per 30-day plan at the entry price (exactly 1 TiB of bytes: quota 1099511627776)
egress.price_per_tb: no per-GB overage; buy the next bandwidth block

record.interface_detail: 'To use Alfafile API you require ... an access token ... by using either of the Alfafile API user/login method'; client libraries are published at /api/doc/library.
record.tooling: documented JSON REST API with token login and client libraries; JDownloader 2 measured 60 MiB/s on a paid account
record.chaining: The only one of the 30-day 1 TiB hosts with a documented public API, so it can be driven headlessly where Rapidgator would need the site.

limits.value: 1 TB of download bandwidth per 30-day plan
free tier measured near 50 KB/s = 0.0477 MiB/s

record.limits_note: Bandwidth is consumed by downloads only; storage is a separate figure on the same plan.
record.binding_note: One 30-day plan is exactly one TiB of bytes, so the counter lands at the monthly requirement with nothing spare.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail signup for the account and token; payment by card.

record.reliability_note: The API blocks an IP after repeated wrong passwords; the vendor asks callers to stop retrying after three failures.
record.confidence_note: Prices, plan shape and API are from the vendor pages read. The free-tier speed is third-party only.

evidence.proved: USD 14.99/30d 1 TB bandwidth + 1 TB storage; 19.99/2 TB; 39.99/4 TB; 'Unlimited simultaneous downloads'; 'Upload/Download files up to 50 GB'
'To use Alfafile API you require the following: A alfafile account ... Access Token ... by using either of the Alfafile API user/login method'
fastest host in the July 2026 test at ~60 MiB/s in JD2; free tier ~50 KB/s

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 14.99 per TiB-month on the 30-day 1 TB plan; the 90-day 4 TB plan is USD 10.00 per TiB-month
record.notes: Priced identically to Rapidgator's 1 TB / 30 day plan with a published API and the fastest measured throughput in the 2026 test. Its weakness is coverage: the same test calls its file availability narrower than Rapidgator.

extras.price_ladder_reported: USD 14.99 / 30 days for 1 TB bandwidth; USD 19.99 / 30 days for 2 TB; USD 39.99 / 30 days for 4 TB; longer plans from USD 39.99 / 90 days for 4 TB
